# PrecisionCAD Studio — Production Release Signing Credentials

This document provides the complete credentials and configuration required to enable automated, signed Production Release APK builds in GitHub Actions for **PrecisionCAD Studio** (`AnimeXplayXD/PrecisionCAD-Studio`).

---

## 1. Required GitHub Actions Repository Secrets

Go to your repository on GitHub:
**`AnimeXplayXD/PrecisionCAD-Studio` -> Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions -> "New repository secret"**

Add each of the following 5 secrets:

| Secret Name | Secret Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`KEY_ALIAS`** | `precisioncad_release` |
| **`STORE_PASSWORD`** | `PrecisionCAD2026ReleaseSecureKey!` |
| **`KEY_PASSWORD`** | `PrecisionCAD2026ReleaseSecureKey!` |
| **`RELEASE_CERT_SHA256`** | `7BBCDA1924E95CA1758C7E0AC763B56AE9F7EAFEF4C6E7362BF2D63C63531E59` |
| **`KEYSTORE_BASE64`** | *(Paste the entire Base64 text from Section 3 below)* |

---

## 2. Keystore Metadata & Technical Verification

- **Keystore File**: `precisioncad-release.p12` (PKCS#12 format)
- **Key Alias**: `precisioncad_release`
- **Key Algorithm**: `RSA 4096-bit`
- **Signature Algorithm**: `SHA384withRSA`
- **Validity**: `10,000 days` (Valid until `2054`)
- **Distinguished Name (DName)**: `CN=PrecisionCAD Studio Release, OU=Mobile Engineering, O=PrecisionCAD Studio, C=US`
- **SHA-256 Certificate Fingerprint**:
  - Formatted: `7B:BC:DA:19:24:E9:5C:A1:75:8C:7E:0A:C7:63:B5:6A:E9:F7:EA:FE:F4:C6:E7:36:2B:F2:D6:3C:63:53:1E:59`
  - Hex continuous: `7BBCDA1924E95CA1758C7E0AC763B56AE9F7EAFEF4C6E7362BF2D63C63531E59`

Keep a copy of `precisioncad-release.p12` in a secure location (e.g., your password manager or secure external drive) so you always have the private signing key for future app updates.
